# Third-party notices: Ultima VIII: Pagan browser port

**About this distribution.** This website hosts a playable browser build of *Ultima VIII: Pagan*. It includes the original game data files, which are © Electronic Arts Inc. / Origin Systems, together with an open-source engine compiled to WebAssembly. Ultima and Pagan are trademarks of their respective owners. This is a non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Electronic Arts. Rights holders with concerns may contact: `jckduncan6@gmail.com`.

**Source code.** The complete corresponding source for the engine (including our modifications), the patched SDL3 and FluidLite libraries, the browser front end and the NPC proxy is available at `https://github.com/BenPomme/ultima8-hd`. Download the complete corresponding source from https://github.com/BenPomme/ultima8-hd/releases/tag/source-v1. The source archive does not contain the original game data files.

**AI dialogue.** Some NPC replies are generated by a large language model via OpenRouter. Memory of your conversations is stored only in your browser and can be erased with "Forget this NPC".

## Engine

ScummVM -- GPL-3.0-or-later. Pinned commit `929be8852be275b23c1cf9a8b036d262a236e8af`.
Source offer and rebuild instructions: `scummvm-source-offer.md`. Patches:
`patches/`. The authoritative licence ships in the release under `doc/`
(`COPYING`, `COPYRIGHT`, `COPYING.*`).

- **SDL 3.2.4** -- zlib licence. Carries the SDL3 Emscripten port patch

- **FluidLite** -- LGPL-2.1-or-later. Short notice at `FluidLite-LICENSE.txt`;

## SoundFonts (separate data files, user-swappable)

SoundFonts are **never** combined into a JS/WASM bundle; they ship (or are
mounted) as standalone `.sf2` files under `fonts/`.

- **GeneralUser GS v2.0.3** -- author licence v2.0, verbatim at
  `GeneralUser-GS-LICENSE.txt`, including the contained-sample provenance
  caveat. `GeneralUser-GS.sf2` sha256
  `9575028c7a1f589f5770fccc8cff2734566af40cd26ed836944e9a5152688cfe`.
- **TimGM6mb** -- GPL-2-only (not "or later"), from the Debian package. Copyright
  2004 Tim Brechbill, 2010 David Bolton. Verbatim at `timgm6mb-copyright.txt`.
  `TimGM6mb.sf2` sha256
  `c5378b62028c920cb11e4803327983fee2f2cdff5dc89c708e39da417e51c854`. Source
  pointer: the Debian `timgm6mb-soundfont` package /
  `musescore/musescore-old@90c33ef9`.
Only the two fonts above are approved and staged. The FluidLite-bundled
`FluidLite-Boomwhacker.sf2` is **not** shipped.

The stack's own Roland SC-55 font is **not** included (unverified/conflicting
provenance). Do not add it.
